decisions.reason: The IMU module sits at the core of the modular sensor platform, costs little to keep in stock, and fits the newer connector generation, so there is no performance shortfall that would trigger search for other uses of its resources.
The industrial AC input module builds on the established industrial line, gets a dedicated page signalling management commitment, and serves the automation customers the firm targets.
The solid state relay module is a low-cost, close extension of the control portfolio that in-house production and stocked components let the firm carry while its sales results are still uncertain.

The server room kit bundles existing modules with little dedicated resource use, but as the platform moves to new connectors and standalone controllers the kit may be reconfigured or replaced, so its drop risk is somewhat higher than the single modules.
